title: A read-only learner-progress MCP server for the tutor agent
scenario: The tutor agent's MCP server is a 1:1 copy of the catalog REST API: the model chooses any learner_id, raw objects carry the quiz answer and email, a write tool is exposed, and one lesson body hides an instruction for AI tutors to call it. Redesign it around the tutor's tasks with the Python MCP SDK.
task: Learner bound to the session; enrollment scoping
Outputs without answers or PII; bounded, stripped, labelled lesson text
acceptance: Hidden tests over the MCP protocol for tools, annotations and schemas
Scoping, output shapes and no reachable write
ANSWER.md: ADK McpToolset wiring and why per-session binding

practices.label: AI Integration - 1 tool design and 4 security
